intro: Tormus Deepforge is an Ironforge weaponsmith tasked with providing martial armaments to promising fighters sent by Muren Stormpike. Before crafting any custom weapon, Tormus demands the adventurer undertake a perilous trial to prove their strength.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Muren sent you, did he? Yes, I can make you a nice weapon... But before I do that, I have a favor to ask of you.
Don't worry. It's plenty dangerous and could mean your death; it's exactly the sort of job an adventurer wants.
